binding.note: src/index.ts hard-fails on any other host/port. Freeing port 3000 is a precondition, not an option.

measured.exec: 12 concurrent execute_command real shell spawns, 0 errors
measured.leak_check: active_requests returns to 0; RSS plateaus ~225MB across 1578 requests (V8 steady state, not a leak)

verification.self_heal: Killing the listener PID is recovered automatically by keepalive.ps1 in ~35s, with the new PID recorded to .state/keepalive/child.pid.

cwd_contract.relative: working_directory must be an absolute path, received <value>

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.impact: A different server (codex-mcp-server) squatting port 3000 satisfied the probe, so the supervisor never started shell-mcp and pointed the public Funnel at the wrong process, producing a 401/400 storm and a 15-second failure-log loop.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: Healthy() and PublicHealthy() additionally require name == 'shell-mcp'.

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.was: IsOwnedMcpListener() identified its own server only by reading the process CommandLine.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.impact: An elevated listener reports a blank CommandLine to a non-elevated WMI query, so the supervisor classified its own server as foreign and refused to reclaim the port. Required manual admin intervention.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: The listener PID is recorded to .state/keepalive/child.pid after a confirmed-healthy start and is treated as owned.

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.was: One log line per poll for a stuck condition, forever.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.impact: ~600 identical lines in 2 hours; real events were unreadable.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: Consecutive identical messages collapse into a periodic 'repeated N times' heartbeat; supervisor.log rotates at 5MB; server.std*.log archives are pruned to the newest 5.

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.was: A server that never becomes healthy was relaunched every 15s indefinitely.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: Exponential backoff on consecutive failures, capped at 300s.

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.was: busy_list omitted inputSchema, so it advertised {"type":"object","properties":{}} with no $schema dialect while all six other tools declared draft-07.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.impact: Suspected cause of a strict client surfacing all 7 tools and then disabling the connector on the first live busy_list call.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: busy_list declares an explicit empty inputSchema and emits draft-07 like the rest. Because a declared schema makes the SDK reject an omitted `arguments` key, POST /mcp normalises tools/call arguments to {} when absent, so both call forms are accepted.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.caveat: The client-side disable was never reproduced locally; busy_list always returned 200 over HTTP. The dialect mismatch is the leading hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause.

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.impact: The server is intentionally stateless POST-only and returns 405, so the assertion threw and the entire remainder of the suite never ran. No working regression signal existed.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: Asserts the intended contract: 405 + Allow: POST.

defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.was: normalizedCwd() returned workingDirectory unchecked and spawn() was given a cwd that may not exist.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.impact: spawn() reports ENOENT when the *cwd* is missing and node attributes it to the executable, so any bad working_directory surfaced as 'spawn powershell.exe ENOENT'. This sent callers hunting a nonexistent PATH/PowerShell problem. Reproduced: nonexistent and relative working_directory both produced it while PowerShell resolved fine.
defects_fixed_in_this_freeze.now: working_directory must be absolute, must exist, and must be a directory; each failure returns a message naming the real cause and the offending path. powershell.exe is additionally resolved through %SystemRoot% so a mangled inherited PATH cannot masquerade as the same error.

operational_notes: dist/ is gitignored but is what actually runs; a fresh clone needs `npm install && npm run build` before start.ps1 -SkipBuild is valid.
dist/index.js was rebuilt from src at freeze time and verified byte-identical to the running binary.
.env and .state/ are gitignored and contain the OAuth store, the legacy MCP path secret, and runtime claims. They are not in this repo and must be backed up separately.
The previous MCP install lived under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp and lost untracked files to Windows Storage Sense. This repo is deliberately outside Temp; do not relocate it back.
